description: Curated Jersey City / Hoboken rebalancing instance for the golden-path demo. Coordinates match the place gazetteer (config/places.py) so each station falls in the same H3 zone the event graph uses. base_target is the desired inventory in a normal hour; the API raises it in event-exposed zones as-of the replay cutoff (a labelled demo heuristic, not the measured Phase 06 model). Two quiet-zone stations (Grove St, Exchange Place) hold the surplus; the three event zones start balanced and go into deficit once the transit / venue events become available.
